intro.p1: Before continuing, you need to connect your HVAC to your current WiFi network.
intro.p2: This can be done using the manufacturer's app, such as EWPE Smart.
intro.static_ip_link: My device has a static IP address →

static_ip.description: Enter the static IP address of your HVAC device. The device must be reachable on your network.
static_ip.label: IP Address
static_ip.skip_scan: Skip UDP scan (use when UDP is blocked)
static_ip.error_no_response: No response from device. Check the IP address and ensure the device is reachable.

warning.title: Important: use a separate Gree account
warning.p1: The Gree cloud allows only one active sign-in per account. When Homey signs in, the Gree+ / EWPE Smart app on your phone is signed out and may warn you that your password is known by someone else. That is expected and does not mean your account was compromised.
warning.p2: To keep using the phone app, create a second Gree account (for example you+homey@example.com), invite it as a family member to your home in the Gree+ app, and sign in here with that second account.
warning.p3: Your e-mail address and password are stored on your Homey and are only used to talk to Gree's servers.

login.description: Sign in with your Gree account. The region must match the one the account was created in — the wrong region always fails to sign in.

error.offline: Your HVAC went offline. Trying to reconnect...
error.not_connected: The HVAC is not connected. The change could not be applied.
error.invalid_static_ip: Invalid IP address. Enter a valid IPv4 address or leave the field empty to use auto-discovery.
error.polling_timeout_too_high: Polling timeout must be lower than the polling interval.

cloud.wrong_region: Sign-in failed. Check that the selected region matches the region of your Gree account.
cloud.network: Could not reach the Gree cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
cloud.rate_limited: The Gree cloud is temporarily refusing requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
cloud.cloud: The Gree cloud returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
cloud.no_devices: No air conditioners were found in this Gree account. Make sure the account is a member of the home that contains the devices.
cloud.session_expired: The Gree cloud signed this app out. Repair this device to sign in again.
cloud.missing_key: The Gree cloud did not provide an encryption key for this device. Remove it and add it again.

deprecated.notification: You are using a deprecated Gree flow card (__card__). It will be removed in a future update — please switch to Homey's built-in thermostat mode flow cards.

cloud.description: Sign in to your Gree account again to restore the connection to this air conditioner.
cloud.device_not_found: This air conditioner is no longer in the Gree account you signed in to.
